mtaSts.none: No MTA-STS policy is set up for this domain.
mtaSts.loadFailed: The MTA-STS policy could not be loaded.
mtaSts.idChanged: The policy identifier changed from {previous} to {current}. Update the TXT record _mta-sts.{domain} in DNS to the new value.
mtaSts.certificateNotice: The server requests the certificate for mta-sts.{domain} and the mta-sts. names of its alias domains at the next run of the certificate service, which can take up to one day. Both DNS records must be published.

deactivate.title: Deactivate the MTA-STS policy?
deactivate.body: The policy of {domain} will no longer be published. Senders that cached it keep applying it for up to its max age. The certificate for its mta-sts. names will no longer be requested.

mtaSts.duplicateDropped: {host} is listed twice and is kept once.

alias.body: The alias domain {aliasDomain} publishes the MTA-STS policy of its target domain {targetDomain}.

list.empty: No MTA-STS policy is set up yet. Policies are set up on the page of a domain.
